author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.39 shipped: EC degraded-data safety, census door-event quality, HVAC Custom Preset Ranges (Batch C)
summary: EC degraded-data safety, census door-event quality, HVAC Custom Preset Ranges (Batch C)
why: The Envoy and cloud battery readings proved unreliable (cloud frozen at 10%, 96 vs 90), and review D showed the drain-precedence release could turn an EV on in the same tick as a 20 kW grid charge; EC now holds every EV and plug start behind the grid-charge gate and trusted SOC (except off-peak and should-start-by). The 10-03 party showed the door ledger double-logging every crossing because Frigate-2 stems bypassed dedup, so the census must fix inputs before any estimator. The Custom Preset Ranges switch re-enabled itself on every restart; Batch C makes it resolve OFF and ship dormant with an empty rollout.
implications: Shipped EC-DEGRADED-DATA-POLICY-1, EC-LKG-NEVER-PERSISTED-1, ENERGY-HISTORY-KW-SUMMED-AS-KWH-1, ENVOY-STREAM-AB-48H-1, CENSUS-INPUTS-FIRST-1, HVAC-CUSTOM-PRESET-RANGES-1, HVAC-COMPOSE-AWAY-THROTTLE-STORM-BLOCKER-1, HVAC-S10-DPM-VS-S1-1, HVAC-RESTORE-WRITERS-STRAND-EMPTY-NIGHT-ZONE-1 at v5.103.39; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.39.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: EV start while charge_from_grid ON, NULL peak_person_count on count-sensor doors, or the CPR switch reading on after restart

refs.release_notes: EC: no EV/plug start during grid charge; untrusted-SOC refusal (option 1); persisted LKG/ledgers; stream tier dormant. Census: door dedup/direction fixes + peak_person_count. HVAC: Custom Preset Ranges ships OFF with empty rollout; switch restart fix; compose-away removed.
